description: Defines the 'FilterInvestInitEvent' class, which is an event class used within the Goteo application's event system. It encapsulates data related to investment initialization, including an investment object, a payment method, and an HTTP request.

classes.name: FilterInvestInitEvent
classes.description: An event class that holds data related to the initialization of an investment, including the investment object, payment method, and HTTP request.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the event with an Invest object, a PaymentMethodInterface object, and an HTTP Request.

methods.name: getInvest
methods.description: Returns the investment object associated with this event.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with this event.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the payment method associated with this event.
